title: Rankable
description: Universal ranking signals any note type may carry. Composed with allOf; deliberately OPEN (it declares no additionalProperties/unevaluatedProperties of its own) so the leaf type is the one that closes the contract.

pinned.description: Pin this note to the top of results in its scope. Dominates every other importance signal.

importance.description: Relative importance, 0-10. Breaks ties between notes that are equally relevant; unset means neutral.
